summary: Paulo Afonso Airport (PAV/SBUF) is a medium-sized regional airport serving the city of Paulo Afonso in the interior of Bahia state, northeastern Brazil. The city is best known for the Paulo Afonso Hydroelectric Complex, one of the earliest and most important hydroelectric developments on the São Francisco River. The airport primarily handles domestic flights and connects this industrial hub to major Brazilian cities.
faqs:
Q: What airlines operate at Paulo Afonso Airport?
A: The airport is primarily served by regional domestic carriers operating scheduled flights to Salvador and other Brazilian cities.

Q: Does Paulo Afonso Airport have international flights?
A: No, PAV handles only domestic flights within Brazil.

Q: How far is the airport from the city center?
A: The airport is located a short drive from downtown Paulo Afonso, making it convenient for travelers.

Q: Are there car rental services available at the airport?
A: Ground transportation options include taxis and local transfer services, though options may be limited compared to larger airports.
transport_tips: Taxis and pre-arranged transfers are the most reliable way to reach the city center from Paulo Afonso Airport. Travelers should confirm return transportation in advance, as ride availability can be limited outside peak flight times. Renting a car in Salvador or another major city before traveling is an option for those planning to explore the broader Bahia interior.
local_tip: If visiting Paulo Afonso, take time to see the Paulo Afonso Hydroelectric Complex viewpoints—the engineering scale of the dam and the dramatic São Francisco River gorge are remarkable and rarely crowded with tourists.
